steps.en: Clone and install editable, with the data/logging extras
steps.zh: 克隆后以可编辑模式安装，带上数据与日志依赖

steps.en: Tokenize a slice of The Pile into an HDF5 token file
steps.zh: 把 The Pile 的一个分片分词成 HDF5 token 文件

steps.en: Launch base pretraining on one or more GPUs
steps.zh: 在一张或多张 GPU 上启动底座预训练

steps.en: Trains the hand-written Transformer on next-token loss; saves checkpoints
steps.zh: 用下一个词预测损失训练手写 Transformer，定期存 checkpoint

steps.en: Start the post-training chain on that base
steps.zh: 在这个底座上启动整条后训练链

steps.en: Runs SFT, reward model, DPO, PPO and GRPO in turn, same backbone each time
steps.zh: 依次跑 SFT、奖励模型、DPO、PPO、GRPO，始终复用同一个骨干

steps.en: Scores every stage's checkpoint on GSM8K and prints one comparison table
steps.zh: 对每个阶段的 checkpoint 跑 GSM8K 评测，打印一张对照表

value.en: A small model you trained yourself, each alignment stage measured on the same axis — no trl, peft or transformers in between
value.zh: 自己从零训出一个小模型，各对齐阶段的效果在同一把尺子上量过，全程不靠 trl、peft 或 transformers

sources: README.md Setup (pip install -e .[train] extras), Step 1 (prepare_pretrain_data.py --split train --num_shards 1 --out data/pile_train.h5), Step 3 (torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node=2 scripts/pretrain_base.py), Run the Whole Thing (bash scripts/run_posttraining.sh)
scripts/run_posttraining.sh at b995104 (SFT -> Reward -> DPO -> PPO -> GRPO, then eval_post_training.py per checkpoint and --table)
grep of all *.py imports at b995104: no transformers / trl / peft imports
